# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and content curation platform where users save and organize ideas through pins and boards across lifestyle categories including fashion, home décor, recipes, DIY, and trending aesthetics.

Pinterest enables users to discover, save, and share visual inspiration across diverse topics from trending fashion items like Adidas Sambas and Campus sneakers to family activities, recipes, and home design. The platform serves as both a social network and personalized discovery engine for lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Visual Discovery
- Content Curation
- Pins and Boards
- Trending Content
- Fashion and Aesthetics
- DIY Crafts
- Food and Recipes
- Home Inspiration
- Family Activities
- Style Trends
- Editorial Content
- Adidas Sambas
- Adidas Campus
- Inspiration Feed

## Core Platform

- [Pinterest Official Profile](https://www.pinterest.com/pinterest/): Official Pinterest brand profile showcasing curated boards and pins

## Discovery and Ideas

- [Explore Ideas (South Africa)](https://za.pinterest.com/ideas/): Pinterest Ideas hub for discovering recipes, home, style inspiration (ZA)
- [Explore Ideas (Australia)](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Pinterest Ideas hub for trend discovery and lifestyle content (AU)
